test_case_name: Accept All Cookies and Navigate to Social Responsibility Page

intents.intent: Click 'Acconsento' on the cookie banner of the parent page
Click 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the child page
Click 'ACCONSENTO' on the cookie banner of the child page
And then check that all cookies are accepted and the social responsibility page is displayed

test_case_name: Access Cookie Policy Options from Parent to Child Page

intents.intent: Click 'Più opzioni' link on the parent page cookie banner
Click 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the child page
Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link on the child page cookie banner
And then check that the cookie policy options are displayed on the child page

test_case_name: Skip to Content on Both Parent and Child Pages

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the child page
Click 'Passa al Contenuto' button on the child page
And then check that the main content of the child page is focused

test_case_name: Open and Use Search Functionality on Child Page After Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Gruppo' link to navigate to the child page
Click the button to open search on the child page
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search input on the child page
Click the 'btn-search' button to submit the search on the child page
And then check that the search results are displayed for $name
